Welcome to Traxial (A Magnax Company): Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we are designing the next generation of high-performance, energy-efficient systems. We're looking for a PE & Motor Control Engineer to join our innovative team and play a pivotal role in creating systems that push boundaries in robotics and industry.
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, develop, and optimize high-efficiency power electronic & motor control systems.
   
 

•  

Create detailed requirements and functional designs for power electronic circuits & motor controllers..
   
 

•  

Perform simulations, testing, and validation to ensure system performance meets all requirements.
   
 

•  

Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the design, prototyping, and manufacturing phases.
   
 

•  

Ensure products are compliant with relevant standards for power drive systems.
   
 

•  

Stay informed about the latest trends and developments in power electronics in robotics & industrial applications.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

A Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Minimum of 3 years of experience in power electronics & circuit design.
   
 

•  

Strong knowledge of inverters and motor controllers.
   
 

•  

Experience with PCB design tools such as Kicad, Altium or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Experience with electronic circuit simulation software such as LTSpice or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Understanding of thermal management and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC).
   
 

•  

Previous experience in model-based design and/or FPGA platforms will be considered a plus.
   
 

•  

A team player with excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
   
 

•  

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Satellit operates a substantial portfolio of mobility assets across multiple European markets and is accelerating its shift toward digital services to improve the customer experience. To support this journey we are hiring a senior Database Administrator to take responsibility for the current database estate, maintain performance, security and availability, and lead the migration from on-premises data centres to a public cloud environment.

Who are you?

Skills & competences:

 
• Conscientiousness
 
• Motivation and positive mindset
 
• Ability to work independently
 
• Quick learning and strong organizational skills
 
• Excellent verbal and written communication
 
• Customer-centric approach
 
• Teamwork
 
• Willingness to ask difficult questions
 
• Professionalism
 
• Transparency and solution orientation

 

Preferred qualifications:

 
• Minimum seven years of hands-on experience administering databases in production environments where availability and reliability are critical, with deep expertise in mainstream commercial relational database systems.
 
• Proven experience designing and operating high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions such as synchronous replication and failover clustering.
 
• Strong proficiency in SQL, including query tuning and execution-plan analysis.
 
• Practical experience deploying and managing database workloads in a public cloud environment, including managed database offerings and cloud-hosted virtual machines.
 
• Experience migrating databases from on-premises infrastructure to cloud platforms is highly desirable.
 
• Familiarity with open-source relational databases is an advantage.
 
• Ability to automate repetitive tasks using scripting or general-purpose programming languages; experience with infrastructure-as-code or CI/CD for database changes is a plus.
 
• Track record of leading database projects such as major version upgrades, consolidation initiatives or security-hardening efforts.
 
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; relevant cloud database or IT service-management certifications are beneficial.
 
• Fluent written and spoken English, plus fluency in either French or Dutch.

What will you do?

 
• Deploy, configure, upgrade, administer, monitor and maintain the organisation's relational databases both on-site and in the cloud.
 
• Define, enforce and document configuration, security and data-integrity standards for databases and related objects; keep operational procedures and technical documentation current.
 
• Design, implement and operate backup, restore and high-availability arrangements, and coordinate regular disaster-recovery exercises.
 
• Assess, plan and execute migration of database workloads to a public cloud platform using managed database services, managed instances or database servers on cloud virtual machines, collaborating with cloud engineers.
 
• Enforce security best practices including least-privilege access, encryption of data at rest and in transit, auditing and patch management.
 
• Act as a primary responder and escalation point for database incidents and service requests, aiming to minimise downtime and service impact.
 
• Carry out root-cause investigations for database issues and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
 
• Review and advise on database schemas and design changes with development teams to ensure scalability, maintainability and security.
 
• Continuously monitor performance and resource usage, perform query and index optimisation, and...
...

jobs.description:
Are you a true foodie who has always dreamed of working in the food industry?

Do you have experience in production and are you ready to turn your passion for snacks into a career? Then we are looking for you!

As a production hero at our food company, you will be responsible for producing the tastiest snacks available.

From mixing the perfect ingredients to controlling the production process, you are the key to our success.

You think it is something for you?

Call Konvert Food Roeselare on the number 051 24 56 29

What we expect from our new production hero:
 

 
• Experience in food production is a plus! (School leavers are also possible!!)
 
• Problem-solving ability
 
• Passion for good food and an eye for quality
 
• Willingness to work in night shift (21h-5h)
 
• Fluent knowledge of English!

What type of breed are we looking for? 
 

Our D2C channel is where we meet pet parents directly. No middleman, no shelf to fight for. It's how we build real relationships with the people (and pets) who love our food.
 

And it's not a side project. Our webshop is a serious business in its own right, representing a significant share of everything we sell, with a subscription base, a real tech team behind it, and years of compounding growth already on the clock. You'd be stepping into something that works, with the mandate to make it considerably bigger.
 

We're looking for a 
D2C & Digital Product Manager to own the roadmap that gets us there. You'll lead our Digital Product Team (2 full stack developers, a data engineer and product designer) and report directly to our Head of D2C.
 

You won't own the P&L. You'll own the roadmap that drives it, which in practice means you decide what we build, in what order, and why.
 

What is in your bowl? 
 

Own the roadmap that drives the channel
 

You decide what we build next and what waits. That means holding a clear point of view on where the growth actually is, translating it into a prioritised roadmap, and defending it when six good ideas arrive in the same week. You'll be measured on whether the channel grows profitably and sustainably, not on how many things got shipped.
 

Turn first-time buyers into a pack that stays
 

First purchase, subscription, loyalty. That's the journey, and it's yours to design end to end. Every step where a pet parent hesitates, churns, or quietly stops caring is a step you get to fix. CAC, LTV, AOV, retention and variable margin are the scoreboard, and CRM is one of your sharpest tools for moving them.
 

Own the campaign calendar
 

Product launches, seasonal moments, always-on lifecycle flows. You plan them, build them with your team, run them, and evaluate them honestly afterwards, together with Brand and Media.
 

Lead a team of four by example
 

Two full stack developers, one data engineer, one product designer. You'll set the direction, protect their focus, coach them, and raise the bar on craft. You won't be doing their jobs, but they should never feel like they're building for someone who doesn't understand what they do.
 

Keep us ahead on new technology
 

Including AI, and including whatever comes after it. You'll have an opinion on which new tools genuinely change the work and which ones are noise, and you'll put the useful ones in front of the team rather than in a deck.
 

Our stack 
 

We've built a headless shop on 
React + Shopify, with 
Klaviyo for CRM and lifecycle and 
Contentful for content. We design in 
Figma and the team runs on 
Notion. You don't need to have used all of it. You do need to be genuinely at home in a modern digital stack.

You're commercial to the bone. You can look at a roadmap and say which item moves LTV and which one just moves a ticket to Done. You've lived with numbers like CAC, AOV, variable margin, retention and forecast accuracy, and when one of them slips you know which lever to reach for.
 

You're hands-on in the engine room. You write the copy for the test yourself rather than waiting three weeks for a copywriter. You click through the feature before it ships. When the data doesn't explain the behaviour, you call a customer. Not because nobody else will, but because you want to know.
 

You've led a team of strong individual contributors. Developers, designers, data people. Specialists who are better at their craft than you are, and who can tell within a week whether you actually respect it. You've given them direction and honest feedback, protected their focus, and helped them get better at what they do. You'll be leading four of them from day one, so this one matters.
 

You live in the middle of Marketing, Design and Technology. You're as comfortable debating a campaign angle as you are reviewing a prototype or talking through a data model with an engineer. Those three worlds meeting is where you do your best work.
 

You prioritise like saying yes has a cost. Because it does. There will always be more good ideas than capacity, and you're the one who decides. You're comfortable being the person who says not this quarter, and explaining why.
 

You build brands, not discounts. You've seen what promo-led growth does to a business over time, and it doesn't excite you. What excites you is a customer who comes back because they love the thing, not because it was 20% off.
 

You know CRM is a craft, not a send button. You've built lifecycle programmes where the timing, the segment and the message all earned their place. You can tell relevant communication from noise, and so can your customers.
 

You get people around you moving without needing the org chart. Brand, Media & Partnerships, Logistics and Finance all have their own plans. You create clarity, you build the shared one, and people follow it because it makes sense.
 

You care about pets. Edgard and Cooper were real dogs, and everything we make still starts from one question: is this actually good for the animal eating it? You need to care about that answer. Ideally you live with a cat or a dog yourself and know exactly how it feels when the food runs out on a Sunday evening. For us this is essential, not a nice-to-have.
 

You bring 5+ years of experience in D2C, e-commerce or digital product, and you're 
fluent in Dutch and English.

About Us: Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027. 
 

Job Description & Key ResponsibilitiesAs a OPEX engineer you will drive the continuous improvement culture within the production facility. In this role you will look beyond the surface, diving deep into the process to eliminate waste and scale manufacturing efficiency to the next level.

• Process Optimization: you are responsible for identifying, implementing, and ensuring process improvements to increase efficiency, quality, and safety.

• Lead independently cross functional improvement projects with minimal supervision.

Responsible for keeping training matrix up-to-date and organizing training accordingly, in collaboration with the production team lead.  

• Identify root causes of technical anomalies/malfunctions or inefficiencies. 

• Provide support with day-to-day technical problems; act as a point of contact for problem solving. 

• Support implementation of new equipment, systems or workflows. 

The role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, preventive way of thinking, a high degree of independence, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team.

• A master’s degree in engineering/biotech with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a continuous Improvement or OPEX role within a manufacturing environment; 

• Proven track record of applying operational excellence techniques as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping (VSM), and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) in a production setting. 

• Analytical and data-driven, out-of-the-box thinking, solution-oriented mindset, and a hands-on approach.
